overall_visual_identity: The reference set consistently presents a low-saturation cool blue-gray dark-fantasy identity with silver-black hard surfaces, sharp elongated forms, and localized blue-white light. Restrained gothic ornament has moderate cross-reference support, while rendering differs between semi-realistic art and flatter stylized UI art.

stable.description: Cool blue-gray and near-black dominate all three independent reference kinds, with silver-white secondary values.
stable.evidence_summary: Character, environment, and UI analyses independently report low-saturation cool blue-gray dominance.

local.description: Red appears on one character cape and one UI badge, both recorded as content-specific rather than global color evidence.
local.evidence_summary: Both red instances belong to specific subjects or objects.

stable.description: Silver metal and black iron or iron-like surfaces recur in character armor, fortress fixtures, and existing UI art.
stable.evidence_summary: The material evidence spans character, environment, and UI reference kinds.

secondary.description: Matte black iron, dark stone, and dark panel fields recur, but their physical identity varies by reference kind.

stable.description: Pointed armor plates, tall fortress forms, and narrow angular UI borders repeat across diverse references.
stable.evidence_summary: Independent character, environment, and UI evidence supports the same contour tendency.

conflicting.description: Character and environment art use semi-realistic digital painting, while the existing UI art uses flatter cel-shaded value grouping.
conflicting.evidence_summary: The difference is explicit in the B1 rendering fields and cannot be reduced to wording variance.

stable.description: Small blue-white luminous regions recur against low-key dark fields in all reference kinds.
stable.evidence_summary: Weapon edges, fortress windows or markers, and UI indicators provide diverse support.

secondary.description: Engraving, arches, finials, pointed corner caps, and sparse crystals recur, but expression and confidence vary by reference kind.
secondary.evidence_summary: The motif family recurs across all sources but is less uniform than color, shape, or lighting.

stable.description: Knight armor, fortress architecture, gothic motifs, and blue-white magical cues provide diverse dark-fantasy support.

uncertain.trait: balance between magical and technological cues
uncertain.description: Blue-white indicators appear across sources, but the B1 evidence does not establish whether they are uniformly magical or partly technological.
uncertain.evidence_summary: The visible cues are consistent in color but ambiguous in world meaning.

cross_dimension_summary: Cool low-saturation color, silver-black hard surfaces, sharp elongated forms, restrained gothic motifs, and localized blue-white light combine into a cold, heavy dark-fantasy expression. Rendering remains split between semi-realistic source art and flatter stylized UI art.

unresolved_conflicts.description: The current evidence does not establish one stable rendering treatment across source art and existing UI art.

uncertainties.description: The shared blue-white light is visually stable, but its world-level interpretation remains ambiguous.

notes: Classification considers reference-kind diversity, source confidence, content specificity, consistency, and unresolved conflict rather than frequency alone.
